$comment: Cash & balance sheet tab and Budget tab settings. The figures come from the raw QuickBooks records (config/raw-sync.json). Restart the server after editing.

cash.$comment: debt: balance sheet subsections and account-name pattern (case-insensitive) counted as debt. runwayMonths: months of operating cash flow averaged for the runway estimate.
cash.debtAccounts: loan|note payable|notes payable|line of credit|mortgage|sba|equipment financing

aging.$comment: topParties: customers / vendors listed in the overdue tables. overdueFrom: first bucket counted as overdue.

vendors.$comment: top: vendors in the group-wide spend table. exclude: vendor names (regex) left out, e.g. payroll services or owners.

budget.$comment: Budgets come from QuickBooks (Budgeting in QBO Plus/Advanced). When a company has several active P&L budgets for the same months, the one whose name matches preferName (regex) wins, otherwise the newest.
